_comment: Per-machine project -> absolute repo-root map for the cross-repo doc viewer (item 19) AND the Roadmap's multi-project scan (R9-8) + display-grouping (R17). COPY this file to `projects.json` (same dir) and edit the paths to your machine. `projects.json` is gitignored — it never ships in the kit (harness-hygiene: no machine paths / product codenames in committed files). Keys are the project tags you use in the conversation tree; values are either a plain absolute-path STRING (legacy form — the project's plans render in the Roadmap's honest '(ungrouped)' section, since no display group is declared) or an OBJECT { "root": "<absolute repo root>", "group": "<top-level display group>" } (the `group` field places the project's plans under a named top-level Roadmap group, e.g. "Pocket Technician" — never guessed/defaulted by the code, only ever what you write here). The conv-tree-ui's OWN repo (this repo) is auto-detected even with no config, and always renders under its own intrinsic "Neural Lace" display group — it needs no entry here.
